items.title: Why the Jensen Huang rally faded so quickly
items.summary: Market Hang tackles the top stories of the day. Including why Monday's Jensen Huang rally faded within a day, what teeth the congressional hearings and board investigation can have given why he was reinstated, and whether the market is sniffing out a peak in the AI CapEx cycle the way it has in past build-outs. The panel debates what the VIX and implied correlations say about last week's selloff, why small caps lagged even in the rally, how a Fed rate hike changes the cost of capital for data center projects, and why investors now have to "take out the pencil" and discount AI earnings years out, before closing with a lighter debate on whether anyone would watch the Super Bowl in an IMAX theater.
